ja: 晴れたら、釣りに行くよ。
en: If it's sunny, I'll go fishing.
alternatives: I'll go fishing if it's sunny.
If the weather's nice, I'll go fishing.
point: 未来のことでも if 節は現在形

ja: 友だちに促され、ヨガを試した。
en: A friend got me to try yoga.
alternatives: A friend talked me into trying yoga.
A friend pushed me to try yoga.
point: get + 人 + to do で「〜してもらう・させる」

ja: 私の陶芸はまだ合格点に届かない。
en: My pottery isn't up to snuff yet.
alternatives: My pottery isn't up to scratch yet.
My pottery still isn't good enough.
point: up to snuff は期待される水準に達していること。

ja: 退職して初めて、絵を描き始めた。
en: Only after retiring did I start painting.
alternatives: I didn't take up painting until I retired.
Not until I retired did I start painting.
point: Only after を前に出すと did I の倒置

ja: 君は何を集めてる？
en: What do you collect?
alternatives: What things do you collect?
What do you like collecting?
point: collect は趣味として物を集める。

ja: 近くに本屋があるよ。
en: There's a bookstore nearby.
alternatives: There's a bookstore near here.
There's a bookstore around here.
point: 「〜がある」は There's + a + 単数名詞

ja: 私が好きなのは山登りです。
en: What I like is hiking.
alternatives: Hiking is what I like.
The thing I like is hiking.
point: 「〜なのは」は What 節で主語にする

ja: 私は唐突な救済展開を作品から削った。
en: I edited the deus ex machina out.
alternatives: I cut out the contrived last-minute plot rescue.
I removed the implausibly convenient plot resolution.
point: deus ex machina は唐突な救済で話を解決する展開。

ja: ハイキングに行こう。
en: Let's go hiking.
alternatives: Let's go for a hike.
Let's go on a hike.
point: 「〜しに行く」は go + -ing

ja: 続けていたら、今ごろ上手なのに。
en: If I'd kept going, I'd be good now.
alternatives: If I'd kept at it, I'd be good now.
I'd be good by now if I'd kept practicing.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は had done と would do

ja: 暇なら毎週ハイキングに行くのに。
en: If I had time, I'd hike weekly.
alternatives: If I were free, I'd go hiking every week.
I'd go hiking weekly if I had the time.
point: if 節は過去形、主節は would + 原形

ja: 写真を加工しなければよかったな。
en: If only I'd left that photo untouched.
alternatives: I wish I hadn't edited that photo.
I wish I'd kept that photo unchanged.
point: leave untouched は手を加えずそのままにすること。

ja: 彼が絵で食えるとは思えない。
en: I doubt what he paints pays the bills.
alternatives: I doubt he makes a living painting.
I don't think his paintings cover his living expenses.
point: pay the bills は生活費をまかなうこと。

ja: 雨でも走るつもりだよ。
en: I'll run even if it rains.
alternatives: Even if it rains, I'll run.
Rain or shine, I'll run.
point: Even if の後は未来でも現在形

ja: このゲームの方が簡単。
en: This game's easier.
alternatives: This game is simpler.
This game's less difficult.
point: easier は easy の比較級。

ja: 近くにジムがあるよ。
en: There's a gym nearby.
alternatives: A gym is nearby.
There's a gym near here.
point: 「〜がある」は There's + 単数の名詞

ja: ヨガ始めてから、はまってる。
en: I've been hooked since I started yoga.
alternatives: I've been hooked on yoga since I started.
I've been hooked ever since I started yoga.
point: since 節は過去形、主節は現在完了

ja: 今読んでる本は、めちゃ面白いよ。
en: The book I'm reading is gripping.
alternatives: The book I'm reading is a real page-turner.
The book I'm reading is fascinating.
point: 「読んでる本」は目的格の関係詞を省略

ja: 妻に誘われて、釣りにはまった。
en: My wife got me hooked on fishing.
alternatives: My wife got me into fishing.
Thanks to my wife, I got hooked on fishing.
point: get + 人 + hooked on で「はまらせる」

ja: 撮影してもいいですか？
en: May I take pictures?
alternatives: Could I take pictures?
Is it okay to take pictures?
point: 丁寧な許可は May I / Could I。take pictures で撮影

ja: 最近、走ってるんだ。
en: I've been running lately.
alternatives: I've been jogging lately.
I've been into running lately.
point: 最近ずっとは have been ＋ -ing ＋ lately

ja: ギターを買ったんだ。
en: I bought a guitar.
alternatives: I got a guitar.
I picked up a guitar.
point: buy の過去は bought。数えられる名詞に a を付ける

ja: 先生に、私は飲み込みが早いって言われた。
en: My teacher said I'm a quick study.
alternatives: My teacher told me I'm a quick study.
My teacher told me I pick things up fast.
point: a quick study は「飲み込みが早い人」の慣用句

ja: 週末、ハイキングに行くかも。
en: I might go hiking this weekend.
alternatives: I may go hiking this weekend.
I might go for a hike this weekend.
point: かもは might でやわらげる

ja: 私は将棋の経験がない。
en: I've never played shogi.
alternatives: I haven't tried shogi yet.
I have no experience playing shogi.
point: never と現在完了で経験がないと伝える。

ja: 私は失敗した写真を省くよ。
en: I'll weed out the bad shots.
alternatives: I'll remove the failed photos.
I'll leave out the unsuccessful photos.
point: weed out は不要なものを選んで取り除く。

ja: 週末は休むといいよ。
en: You should rest this weekend.
alternatives: Take it easy this weekend.
Try to rest this weekend.
point: 「〜するといい」の助言は should + 動詞の原形

ja: 彼は相当練習したに違いない。
en: He must have practiced like crazy.
alternatives: He must have put in countless hours.
He must have logged countless hours of practice.
point: must have + 過去分詞は過去への確信。like crazy は「猛烈に」

ja: 私は絵の腕を磨きたい。
en: I want to refine my painting.
alternatives: I'd like to improve my painting skills.
I want to hone my painting skills.
point: refine は細部を磨いて質を高める。

ja: 先週、釣りに行ったよ。
en: I went fishing last week.
alternatives: Last week I went fishing.
I went out fishing last week.
point: 「行く」の過去は went。「釣りに行く」は go fishing

ja: 私は抑えた哀感を滅多に見たことがない。
en: Rarely have I seen such understated pathos.
alternatives: I've rarely seen such understated sorrow.
I've seldom seen sadness expressed with such restraint.
point: understated pathos は大げさに表さない哀感。

ja: 君はどこで泳ぐ？
en: Where do you swim?
alternatives: Where do you go swimming?
Where's your swimming spot?
point: where で泳ぐ場所を尋ねる。

ja: 陶芸を勧めてくれたのは、姉だった。
en: It was my sister who suggested pottery.
alternatives: It was my sister who got me into pottery.
My sister was the one who suggested pottery.
point: It was ~ who で「人」を強調する

ja: 知ってたら、参加したのに。
en: If I'd known, I'd have joined.
alternatives: If I had known, I'd have joined.
Had I known, I'd have joined in.
point: 過去の事実の逆は If＋had 過去分詞、would have 過去分詞

ja: 弟は今ゲームをしているよ。
en: My brother's playing games now.
alternatives: My brother is playing a video game.
My brother is playing games right now.
point: 今の動作は is ＋ -ing

ja: 私は菓子作りが好き。
en: I enjoy making desserts.
alternatives: I like making sweets.
I like baking desserts.
point: enjoy の後は making のように動名詞。

ja: 週末はキャンプに行くんだ。
en: I'm going camping this weekend.
alternatives: I'm going to go camping this weekend.
I'm heading out camping this weekend.
point: 決まった予定は現在進行形で言える

ja: 写真に熱中して、私は散財した。
en: Bitten by the photography bug, I splurged.
alternatives: Hooked on photography, I splurged.
Hooked on photography, I spent a fortune.
point: photography bug は写真への熱中を表す。

ja: 開演は何時か知ってる？
en: Do you know when it starts?
alternatives: Do you know what time it starts?
Any idea when it starts?
point: 間接疑問は when の後が平叙文の語順

ja: その頃、もう陶芸は諦めていた。
en: By then, I'd given up on pottery.
alternatives: By that point, I'd given up on pottery.
I'd already given up on pottery by then.
point: その時点より前の出来事なので had given up

ja: 祭りは毎年夏に開かれる。
en: The festival is held every summer.
alternatives: The festival takes place every summer.
They hold the festival every summer.
point: 「開かれる」は is held の受動態

ja: もっと練習してたら、勝てたのに。
en: If I'd practiced more, I'd have won.
alternatives: If I'd trained harder, I'd have won.
Had I practiced more, I'd have won.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had + 過去分詞

ja: 誘ってくれてもよかったのに。
en: You could've invited me along.
alternatives: You could have at least invited me.
You might have asked me to come.
point: could have + 過去分詞で「〜してくれてもよかった」と不満

ja: 日曜の陶芸教室に通ってる。
en: I take a Sunday pottery class.
alternatives: I go to a Sunday pottery class.
I attend a pottery class on Sundays.
point: 教室に通うは take a class が自然

ja: 私は兄に伴奏を頼んだ。
en: I asked my older brother to accompany me.
alternatives: I asked my older brother to provide accompaniment.
I asked my older brother for accompaniment.
point: accompany は歌に合わせて楽器で伴奏する。

ja: 最近、ヨガを始めたんだ。
en: I took up yoga recently.
alternatives: I've taken up yoga recently.
I recently took up yoga.
point: 趣味を始めるは take up

ja: 私の趣味は写真です。
en: My hobby is photography.
alternatives: Photography is my hobby.
I'm into photography.
My hobby is taking photos.
point: 趣味は My hobby is 〜。photography は a を付けない

ja: 初心者でも、ギターは楽しいよ。
en: Guitar is fun, even for beginners.
alternatives: Guitar is fun even for a beginner.
Even for a beginner, guitar is fun.
point: even for ~ で「〜でも」の譲歩

ja: 私が合唱団やめたって、誰が言ったの？
en: Who said I'd quit the choir?
alternatives: Who told you I'd quit the choir?
Who said I had quit the choir?
point: quit の時制は主節に合わせて I'd quit

ja: もっと早く楽器を始めればよかった。
en: I wish I'd taken up an instrument earlier.
alternatives: If only I'd taken up an instrument sooner.
I wish I had started playing an instrument sooner.
point: 「始める」趣味は take up。過去の後悔は wish + had done

ja: 私、ギター弾けるよ。
en: I can play guitar.
alternatives: I can play the guitar.
I'm able to play guitar.
point: 楽器名の前の the は付けても付けなくてもよい
